name: fitness centre
trans: n. phrase 健身中心

name: coach
trans: n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team

name: session
trans: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions; the time during which a school holds classes

name: weight
trans: n. the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity

name: injury
trans: n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.; an accident that results in physical damage or hurt

name: champion
trans: n. someone who has won first place in a competition; someone who fights for a cause

name: volunteer
trans: n. (military) a person who freely enlists for service; a person who performs voluntary work

name: income
trans: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time

name: donation
trans: n. a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause

name: investment
trans: n. the act of investing; laying out money or capital in an enterprise with the expectation of profit; money that is invested with an expectation of profit

name: grant
trans: n. any monetary aid; the act of providing a subsidy

name: sponsor
trans: v. assume sponsorship of; assume responsibility for or leadership of
n. someone who supports or champions something

name: fundraising
trans: v. raise money for a cause or project

name: instrument
trans: n. a device that requires skill for proper use; the means whereby some act is accomplished

name: flute
trans: n. a high-pitched woodwind instrument; a slender tube closed at one end with finger holes on one end and an opening near the closed end across which the breath is…

name: clarinet
trans: n. a single-reed instrument with a straight tube

name: perform
trans: v. carry out or perform an action; perform a function

name: rehearsal
trans: n. a practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)

name: festival
trans: n. a day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration

name: carnival
trans: n. a festival marked by merrymaking and processions

name: firework
trans: n. (usually plural) a device with an explosive that burns at a low rate and with colored flames; can be used to illuminate areas or send signals etc.

name: poster
trans: n. a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement

name: fee
trans: n. a fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services

name: facility
trans: n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry

name: hall
trans: n. an interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open; a large entrance or reception room or area

name: gallery
trans: n. spectators at a golf or tennis match

name: complex
trans: n. a conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts; a compound described in terms of the central atom to which other atoms are bound or coordinated

name: exhibition
trans: n. the act of exhibiting; a collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display

name: sculpture
trans: n. a three-dimensional work of plastic art; creating figures or designs in three dimensions
